Flow.description: Keeps the three Actual_*_Week_Dashboard__c fields in sync with their corresponding Actual_*_Week_Number__c formula fields, and Lead_Created_Quarter_Dashboard__c in sync with Lead_Created_Quarter_No__c, going forward on every create/update of a Prospect (Lead__c) - so the Pro-Active Pipeline dashboard can filter/query on plain, groupable fields instead of the non-groupable formula fields directly. Does NOT backfill existing records (those need a separate one-time update, per explicit decision to avoid touching the other automation on this object with a bulk update outside this flow). Runs after-save (not before-save) because formula fields aren't yet recalculated at the before-save stage of the save order - Salesforce rejects referencing a formula field from a before-save flow outright. Entry condition fires on every create (ISNEW()) - needed because Lead_Created_Quarter_No__c is fixed at creation and never changes, so relying on ISCHANGED alone would leave it blank forever on any Lead that never touches one of the three milestone date fields - or when one of the three milestone date fields changes on update. This flow's own record update never touches those date fields, so it never re-triggers itself.
Flow.label: Lead Sync Actual Week Numbers
